questions.q: What does an IPF logic condition consist of?
options: A mission line with a condition
The number of a logic rule in the mission list
A timer that starts the rule

questions.q: The default GVAR range (without the gvar command)?
questions.explain: By default the min/max of every GVAR is −32768…32767; the command gvar <i> <default> <min> <max> changes the limits (they are stored as int32).

questions.q: To write to GVAR 1, operand A must be…
questions.explain: The index is given as a Value; “Global Variable 1” means the value inside GVAR 1.

questions.q: When is it better to replace IPF with Lua/ArduPilot?
options: When there are dozens of rules
questions.explain: IPF is rules without loops or functions.

questions.q: Why may the rules break after an INAV upgrade?
options: All GVARs are reset on flashing
questions.explain: Check against the tables of your version. Between 8.0.1 and 9.1.0 the numbers did not shift: operations 55–56 and operands 46–49 were appended at the end.

questions.q: Override RC channel in IPF conflicts with:
options: The real stick on the same channel
The PID and the OSD at once
questions.explain: A virtual channel is better for modes.

questions.q: What is a Programming PID in INAV?
options: A configurable controller whose output is available in the logic
The PID of the rate loop in the flight loop
PID autotune from Blackbox logs after the flight
An ESC temperature controller on DShot telemetry in real time
questions.explain: Four programmable PID controllers; their output can be used in logic conditions.
